response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 as region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) as avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) as region_avg_amount, AVG(avg_balance) as region_avg_balance FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), global_mean AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) as global_mean_amount FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.region_avg_amount, r.region_avg_balance, r.region_avg_amount / g.global_mean_amount as ratio FROM region_averages r CROSS JOIN global_mean g WHERE g.global_mean_amount IS NOT NULL
